name: Tenshi-tachi no Gogo
source:
The goal is to seduce the star girl of the tennis club, Yumiko Shiraishi. To do this, the player needs to go around talking with her friends and possibly getting intimate with them as well.

[from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tenshitachi_no_gogo]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
游戏目标是诱惑网球社的明星选手白石由美子。为此，玩家需要四处与她的朋友交谈，也可能会与这些朋友发展出亲密关系。

[引自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tenshitachi_no_gogo]维基百科[/url]]
